about_the_game:
Mr. Ghosh-er Adventure is a Narrative Horror Adventure game where you play as a Detective and unravel the mystery of a seemingly simple murder case that unfolds itself into something much bigger and scarier.

Mr. Ghosh-er Adventure is a game taking place in a quite secluded small town with a closed society that is partly welcoming to the detective, partly unwelcoming. This game involves the player making deductions about crime scenes, the loop is to investigate places, talk to folks, get leads, solve puzzles in both worlds, progress, get further leads, connect dots, manage time. You traverse through two realms, one being the normal world where Detective does scene and item investigation, talk to folks and get leads on cases while in other world the Detective faces the real horror of the game, where, while encountering inhumane hostile entities, you further learn about something relevant to the case.
